definitions.explanation: A person or entity that produces goods, especially agricultural products or manufactured items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生産者|せいさんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧。
{生産者|せいさんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: To choose vegetables where you can see the producer's face.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生産者|せいさんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧や⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At this roadside station, producers sell vegetables and fruits directly.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ (production) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Commonly used for farmers, fishermen, and other primary producers, but also applicable to manufacturers. In the food industry, {生産者|せいさんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (being able to see the producer's face) has become a marketing concept emphasizing traceability and trust.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}{直売|ちょくばい}: direct sales from the producer
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: producer price
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: producer information
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生産者|せいさんしゃ}: local producers
- {生産者|せいさんしゃ}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: producers' association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧: consumer — the counterpart, one who uses/buys the product
- {製造者|せいぞうしゃ}: manufacturer — specifically for factory-made goods
- ⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧: farmer — specifically a farming household
